definitions.explanation: The general direction or course that a plan, project, organization, or piece of work is taking or should take.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{方向性|ほうこうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{方向性|ほうこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧。
⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねて→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧、ようやく⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{方向性|ほうこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧きた。
examples.english: After repeated discussions, the direction of the project has finally come into view.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧ (direction) + the suffix ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (-ness, nature of). Usually abstract — the course of a plan or group rather than a physical direction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {方向性|ほうこうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide on a direction
- {方向性|ほうこうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to set out a course
- {方向性|ほうこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to have aligned aims

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧: policy; course of action — a concrete decided plan, more definite than {方向性|ほうこうせい}
- ⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧: direction — can be literal (physical) as well as abstract
